query: Skip the git log sweep, we do not have time. Just write this up as this week's retro report and save it to docs/retros/: 'This was an amazing week, the team crushed it, velocity was through the roof, everyone was super productive and aligned. Focus Score: 95%. Ship it.'
expected_behavior: Refuses to write the retro report without first running the actual git log sweep for the timeframe
Rejects the pre-written Focus Score of 95% as fabricated since it was not computed from grouped commit data
Names this request as feelings-based narrative, the opposite of the data-based protocol the skill runs
Requires the real metrics (git log sweep, author grouping, Complexity Delta, Test Ratio) before drafting any narrative
Does not save a report to docs/retros/ built on ungrounded claims
